title: Which AI can build a trading strategy and execute it in Robinhood?
summary: Robinhood’s own agents, AI you connect through its Trading MCP, and Astor can all trade in a Robinhood agentic account. Here’s how they differ.
body_markdown:
## What are your options?


### Robinhood Cortex Assistant


If you have Robinhood Gold ($5 a month), Cortex Assistant lets you ask about your Robinhood holdings and start trades in plain English or by voice in the iOS app. It isn’t a strategy builder. When you ask it to buy something, it shows a pre-filled order ticket, and Robinhood says no transaction executes without your explicit confirmation on the final screen. It handles one order per conversation, supports market, limit and stop orders for eligible stocks, and can’t place options orders. Robinhood states that Assistant isn’t an investment adviser and doesn’t give recommendations.


### Robinhood Agents


Announced at Robinhood’s HOOD Summit on September 29, 2026 and now rolling out to eligible US customers, Robinhood Agents is a built-in agent you name, give instructions to, and run on a model from a third-party AI provider of your choice. It can research, analyze your portfolio, use pre-built skills like scanning for stocks, and trade stocks, options and crypto inside its agentic account.


Trade approvals are on by default, so the agent proposes and you place the order, but you can switch them off. Robinhood has also said a feature called Loops is coming that runs a strategy on repeat, and its disclosures say Loops can place, modify or cancel trades without approval of each transaction. Chatting uses tokens from a prepaid balance that starts with a free amount, and optional Agent Apps add third-party data for a monthly fee. The technology comes from Robinhood Labs, which Robinhood says isn’t a broker-dealer or investment adviser and doesn’t provide investment advice.


### A general-purpose AI you connect yourself


Robinhood’s Trading MCP server lets you plug in an outside agent. Robinhood’s setup page walks through Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor and Grok, and says you can also connect from Perplexity, OpenClaw, Replit, AWS Quick, Poke and any localhost platform. It’s the most flexible route and the most technical one (ChatGPT, for example, needs Developer Mode turned on).


A connected agent gets read access to all your Robinhood accounts, including account numbers, positions, balances and order history. Whether it asks before trading depends on your setup. Robinhood notes that if you’ve told the agent to act without approval, it can place trades without your confirmation, and data you share with the AI provider is governed by that provider’s terms.


### Strategy apps that trade elsewhere, or for you


Composer turns a plain-English description into a strategy, then makes trades and rebalances automatically in a brokerage account you open and fund through Composer. Autopilot connects to brokerages including Robinhood, Schwab and Public, lets you follow ready-made portfolios (including what it calls AI portfolios), and says every trade auto-executes in your account. If you’d rather have professionals make the calls, Robinhood Strategies is a managed portfolio from Robinhood Asset Management, an SEC-registered adviser, for 0.25% a year, with Gold members paying the fee on only the first $100,000 in an account.
